risk_summary: The excerpt provides useful quantitative disclosures on profitability, relisting history, supplier concentration, and financing, but contains substantial standard forward-looking disclaimers and uncertainty language. Key risks include prior Nasdaq delisting, COVID-19 disruption, supply-chain shortages, rising logistics and labor costs, customer credit exposure, and reliance on related-party manufacturers. Management maintains a generally confident operating tone while acknowledging that the pandemic’s financial impact cannot be predicted.
